Smart Island stopped because its accessibility overlay was turned off. Tap to turn it back on.
Smart Island lost notification access. Tap to grant it again.
%1$s closes apps it thinks are idle. Turn on Auto-start for Smart Island, then open Recents, long-press Smart Island and tap Lock so it is never cleared.
So only the island shows new alerts, turn off "Pop on screen" (heads-up) and Bubbles for your messaging apps in Android\'s notification settings.
Lets Smart Island notify you if a permission is turned off and the island stops.
Hides system status-bar icons such as alarm, Bluetooth, NFC and rotate so they do not crowd the island. Battery, clock, Wi-Fi and signal stay. Needs a one-time ADB grant.
